description: This header file defines the ActivityMonitor class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class implements a plugin interface with JSONRPC capabilities, providing methods to retrieve memory usage statistics, enable/disable monitoring, and handle related events. It also manages threading and synchronization for monitoring activities.

classes.name: ActivityMonitor
classes.description: A plugin class that inherits from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, responsible for monitoring application memory and CPU usage, managing monitoring state, and handling related events.

methods.name: getApplicationMemoryUsage
methods.description: Retrieves current application memory usage statistics.

methods.name: onMemoryThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Event handler for memory threshold breaches.

methods.name: onCPUThresholdOccurred
methods.description: Event handler for CPU threshold breaches.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell environment.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.
